_comment: Travel objects (docs/spider-caverns-plan.md section 4). `nodes`: fixed places a player can travel from/to. kind hearth = a fireplace of the Emberway: the player stands within `hearth.radius`, opens the Hearth window (interact), picks a known fireplace and pays `hearth.cost` x `hearth.item`; the authority checks distance, item, combat and level (every hearth of the network is open; a destination's `level_min` is the only gate), then moves the body through the ordinary transfer (same map or not) to the arrival point `arrive` metres in front of the destination hearth. pos y = 0 on the grounds means 'on the terrain'. yaw (degrees) is the direction the hearth faces (the room side). Hearths a character has stood at are still remembered (hearth_known) but no longer gate travel. kind cabinet / passage (S7): free twin links - interact at one to be set down in front of its `pair` (no item, nothing to learn).

stone_raven.label: the Dry Cistern
stone_raven.prompt: Lift the cistern grate and climb down

waylink._comment: A Waystake (protocol v21). The owner places it (consumed) and picks a destination; for countdown_s the owner's party members within grab_radius may hold on (interact). When it fires, everyone still holding and still within reach is carried together to the destination (a travel node), set down together at a random open spot `scatter` metres [min, max] from it (ground found by a ray, no water, no roof, no steep slope), in a small ring; `arrive` metres in front of it when no spot is found. Refunded if it cannot fire (nobody left holding, owner gone). Not inside dungeon copies, not mounted, not within combat_lock_s of combat. Alone (no party), the countdown is solo_countdown_s (also 10 s: the boot always counts down from ten); the boot is set place_ahead metres in front of the owner.

cabinet._comment: Old Shafts: a pair of hatches, free, one person; climbing into one sets you down in front of its `pair`.

passage._comment: Secret passages (the Dry Cistern): free, one person, to the node named `pair`.
